output.subject: Code blocks that actually work in email
output.pitch: Developers running programming newsletters struggle with platforms that break code formatting and lock in their content. Lettercraft solves this by letting writers author in Markdown, store posts in their own Git repo, and publish with a git push. Every code block is verified to render with syntax highlighting across 14 email clients. 1,100 technical writers used it during beta to ship clean, readable code-heavy emails. The subscriber list exports in one click — no lock-in. For your audience of developer-focused creators, this is a real alternative to Substack or beehiiv. {APP_URL}
